description: This file defines the DraftService class, which provides methods for managing draft data product packages, including creation, retrieval, and listing of drafts, with integrations to database and audit services.

classes.name: DraftService
classes.description: Service for draft lifecycle management, handling creation, retrieval, and listing of draft data product packages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_draft( self, package: Dict[str, Any], actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new draft data product package and records an audit event.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_draft(self, draft_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a draft by its ID, parsing the stored JSON package data.

methods.name: list list_drafts(self, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Lists all drafts, optionally filtered by a user ID, sorted by creation time.
